description: This file provides a safe API for interacting with the /proc filesystem on Linux, including functions for verifying, mounting, and accessing process-specific information in a secure manner. It defines a Handle type for /proc, methods for opening and reading links, and mechanisms to ensure safety against overmounts and race conditions.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A wrapper around an *os.File handle to /proc, used for safe operations within the /proc filesystem.

methods.name: verifyProcHandle
methods.description: Checks if a given fd is from a procfs filesystem by verifying its superblock type.

methods.name: verifyProcRoot
methods.description: Verifies if a given fd is the root of a procfs mount by checking inode number.

methods.name: newHandle
methods.description: Creates a new Handle object after verifying the fd is a valid procfs root.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying fd of the Handle.

methods.name: OpenProcRoot
methods.description: Returns a safe handle to /proc, caching the subset=pid handle.

methods.name: OpenUnsafeProcRoot
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc without safety guarantees.

methods.name: Readlink
methods.description: Performs a safe readlink on /proc/<base>/<subpath> with overmount checks.

methods.name: ProcSelfFdReadlink
methods.description: Gets the real path of a file descriptor via /proc/thread-self/fd/$n.

methods.name: CheckProcSelfFdPath
methods.description: Verifies if a file handle matches an expected path.

methods.name: ReopenFd
methods.description: Reopens an existing fd via /proc/thread-self/fd/<fd> to upgrade O_PATH to a regular fd.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Core method to open /proc/<base>/<subpath> with safety checks.
